items.reason: The excerpt defines a floating charge as one on all assets excluding those assigned to secured creditors, which matches the question.
The excerpt says cheques drawn on savings or current accounts (demand deposits) can be refused by anyone, which is why they are not legal tender; the other options are contradicted or irrelevant.
The excerpt states that a revenue deficit means the government is dissaving and using other sectors' savings to finance part of its consumption expenditure.
The passage mentions 'two missed sessions' but never states how many volunteers failed to update the noticeboard, so none of the numbers is supported.

The excerpt's sales-person example (marketing manager allows 10%, finance tells her not to exceed 5%) is the textbook violation of unity of command, defined as receiving orders from only one superior.
The excerpt lists the four elements of directing as supervision, motivation, leadership and communication; staffing is a separate management function.
Optimistic means expecting good things to happen; the captain kept asserting a win despite losing, so optimistic fits. Sceptical is the opposite.
The excerpt defines irredeemable (perpetual) debentures as those where the company gives no undertaking to repay, repayable only on winding up or after a long period.
The excerpt says quick assets exclude inventories and other current assets such as prepaid expenses; cash, trade receivables and bills receivable are kept.
Old shares P 3/5, Q 2/5; new shares P 2/5, Q 2/5. Sacrifice P = 3/5 - 2/5 = 1/5, Q = 2/5 - 2/5 = 0, so the ratio is 1 : 0.
The excerpt lists sale of shares in PSUs (disinvestment) as a capital receipt that reduces financial assets; GST, dividends and income tax are revenue receipts.

The excerpt says staffing includes recruitment, selection, training, development, promotion, compensation and performance appraisal, so recruitment, training and performance appraisal are all correct; the item has no single key.
Indifferent means having no interest; inquisitive means very interested in learning, the opposite. The other options are not antonyms.

Current assets = inventories 60,000 + trade receivables 40,000 + prepaid expenses 5,000 + cash 15,000 = 1,20,000 (prepaid expenses are current assets per the excerpt). Current liabilities = trade payables 70,000 + bank overdraft 10,000 = 80,000. Ratio 120,000 : 80,000 = 1.5 : 1.
The excerpt shows that with reserves of 100 at a 20 per cent ratio, total deposits rise until reserves equal 100, i.e. deposits of 100 / 0.20 = 500.
The excerpt states simplification aims at eliminating superfluous varieties, sizes and dimensions, while standardisation devises new varieties.
